mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy phase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and consumer spending (RSAFS) rises above 350000, it indicates an overheating economy that triggers Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5 AND RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that often precedes Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening economy, which typically triggers expectations of monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI growth rate exceeds 2.0% annually, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise above 2% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 2%, it signals an economy with a booming housing market and weakening manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth rate > 2% AND INDPRO growth rate < -2%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST growth rate > 2% AND INDPRO growth rate < -2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of employees (PAYEMS) falls below 135000, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed may cut rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
